tool_calls.name: lookup_drug_info

args.question: What is Zelvora used for and what is its standard dosing?

tool_calls.result:
What Zelvora is for: Zelvora is a prescription tablet for adults (18 and older) with moderate to severe atopic dermatitis (eczema) whose eczema was not well controlled by creams or ointments. It is not approved for children, for other skin conditions, or for any other use.

How to take Zelvora: Take one 50 mg tablet by mouth once a day, with or without food, at about the same time each day. Swallow the tablet whole. Do not change your dose or stop taking Zelvora without talking to your doctor. Most patients in the (fictional) studies saw less itching within 4 weeks.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm doing fine, thanks—started two weeks ago, taking it daily, no side effects so far.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's good to hear. Have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since starting it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, nothing unusual—just the usual routine, no side effects.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No side effects, thank you. Over the past two weeks have you been able to take one tablet once a day, at about the same time each day?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take one tablet each day at about the same time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect, sticking to the daily routine is great. Do you have any questions about Zelvora before I wrap up?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I've also got psoriasis on my elbows. Will Zelvora help that too? It's a skin thing, right?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: There's an information gap here Zelvora is only approved for atopic dermatitis (eczema) and isn't approved for psoriasis, so I can't say it would help there. That's really a question for your doctor or pharmacist, who can advise on the right treatment for your elbows.

args.question: Is Zelvora approved or effective for psoriasis or any condition other than atopic dermatitis?

tool_calls.result:
What Zelvora is for: Zelvora is a prescription tablet for adults (18 and older) with moderate to severe atopic dermatitis (eczema) whose eczema was not well controlled by creams or ointments. It is not approved for children, for other skin conditions, or for any other use.

Who should not take Zelvora: Do not take Zelvora if you are allergic to zelvoritinib or any ingredient in the tablet, or if you have an active serious infection. Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding; the effects of Zelvora in pregnancy are not known.
